# funnel_custom_dimension (Resource)

Manages a custom dimension in a Funnel workspace. Rules in `derived` are easiest to build in the Funnel UI. Import the dimension afterwards, or copy it to other workspaces with the `funnel_custom_dimension` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# String type custom dimension
resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "campaign_type" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Campaign Type"
  description = "Categorizes campaigns by their marketing strategy type"
  unit        = "string"
}

# Date type custom dimension
resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "launch_date" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Campaign Launch Date"
  description = "The date when the campaign was first launched"
  unit        = "date"
}

# DateTime type custom dimension
resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "last_updated" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Last Updated Timestamp"
  description = "Timestamp of the last data update"
  unit        = "datetime"
}

# Dimension with rules, here copied from the Funnel UI. `=case` branches are evaluated in order.
resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "brand" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Brand"
  description = "Brand name for all data"
  unit        = "string"
  derived = jsonencode({
    expr = {
      "=case" = [{
        "=when" = true
        "=then" = {
          "=case" = [{
            "=when" = true
            "=then" = { "=value" = [{ "=string" = "Test Brand" }] }
          }]
        }
      }]
    }
  })
}

# Rules exported from the Funnel UI and kept in a file
resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "from_file" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Market"
  description = "Rules maintained in the Funnel UI"
  unit        = "string"
  derived     = file("${path.module}/market.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Custom dimension description. Will be displayed in the Funnel UI.
- `name` (String) Custom dimension name
- `unit` (String) Custom dimension unit type. One of `string`, `date`, or `datetime`.
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID. Must be exactly 20 characters (letters, digits, `-` and `_`).

### Optional

- `derived` (String) JSON-encoded rules for how the dimension is calculated, in Funnel's expression format. Easiest to build in the Funnel UI, then import the dimension or copy it with the `funnel_custom_dimension` data source. `=case` branches are evaluated in order. Built-in field IDs work in any workspace, but references to custom fields should use the field's Terraform `id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom dimension ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Import a dimension set up in the Funnel UI. Run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf` to have Terraform write its configuration, including `derived`.
import {
  to = funnel_custom_dimension.example
  id = "<workspace_id>/<custom_dimension_id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import funnel_custom_dimension.example <workspace_id>/<custom_dimension_id>
```
